description: This file contains the NotesController class for handling note-related operations in SuiteCRM, such as saving and editing notes, managing file uploads, and deletion of attachments.

classes.name: NotesController
classes.description: Controller class for managing note-related actions including save and edit view.

methods.name: action_save
methods.description: Handles the saving of a note, including file upload management and assignment logic.

methods.name: action_editview
methods.description: Prepares the edit view for a note, including attachment deletion if requested.
